description: Royal Cavalry Lance (왕도 기병창): a long cavalry lance of polished steel with a slim leaf-shaped head, a dull-gold royal guard ring below the head and a short pennon of plain slate-blue cloth (Thea's color), no emblem.
Royal Chaplain Mace (왕도 사제 철퇴): a flanged steel mace with a plain ivory-and-gold grip and a small round guard, clean and bright, a chaplain's weapon of the capital, no holy symbol.
The King's Signet (왕의 인장): a heavy old gold signet ring with a plain smooth dark-violet stone (no engraving), a faint warm violet glow around it (the last king's ring).
The Herald's Horn (전령의 뿔피리): a curved brass herald's horn with a plain cream cord and a worn leather grip, a soft pale-gold glow at its mouth as if a call still lingers.
